{{Top|leg}}
A '''space-skeet blaster''' was a hand held weapon designed for shooting [[Skeet/Legends|skeets]] with. They had a maximum range of three hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]], and sold for around five hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
